title: An FR icon for Fury Remastered
summary: Fury Remastered has a compact FR monogram for browser tabs and the T3 project.
details: The landing page, game, dev log, and stats page use a scalable SVG, with ICO fallbacks at 16, 32, and 48 pixels. The T3 project uses a 96-pixel PNG. The installed web app keeps its Home Screen wordmark.
Release icon tests and all 14 service worker tests passed locally.
